events.description: 5. TEXT ORDER: Pursuant to the discussions at the telephone conference held this date, the court AMENDS the schedule entered in TO 31, as to certain deadlines, as follows: Any motion that should be considered from the State, alongside private plaintiffs' pending motions, including any motions for Preliminary Injunction filed by the United States, motions shall be filed by October 2, 2024; any response is due by October 9, 2024; and any reply is due by October 14, 2024. The court RESETS the In-Person motion hearing from October 17, 2024 at 10:00 AM to October 15, 2024 at 12:30 PM, in Courtroom 8, Hugo L. Black United States Courthouse, Birmingham, Alabama. Further, the court RESETS the status conference set for October 3, 2024 at 1:00 PM to October 4, 2024 at 2:30 PM and CONVERTS said status conference from telephone to Zoom. Both hearings will be held before Judge Anna M. Manasco. The court will provide the Zoom information to the parties by separate email. Signed by Judge Anna M Manasco on 9/30/2024. Associated Cases: 2:24-cv-01254-AMM, 2:24-cv-01329-AMM(FNC) (Entered: 09/30/2024)

events.description: 43. TEXT ORDER: As the court previously discussed with the parties during a teleconference, the court has concerns that allowing expert testimony in connection with preliminary injunction proceedings that are necessarily occurring on an extremely compressed timetable (i.e., one that does not afford any opportunity for a rebuttal expert to be disclosed, let alone prepare a report or testimony) is fundamentally unfair to the defendants in these cases. Accordingly, the private plaintiffs are ORDERED to show good cause, if there is any, why the court should not exclude the report and testimony of their expert witness in connection with the preliminary injunction proceedings in these cases, not later than NOON Central Time on Monday, October 14, 2024. If the United States wishes to take a position, it is DIRECTED to do so by the same deadline. Signed by Judge Anna M Manasco on 10/13/2024. Associated Cases: 2:24-cv-01254-AMM, 2:24-cv-01329-AMM (WPP) (Entered: 10/13/2024)
